pages.text: Your own living $(l)Team Lead$(), an empty jar big enough for its head in your off hand, the Surgical Saw in your main hand: $(l)Use$(). The half-health rule is waived. It has agreed.

Eight seconds: DOLORES makes the offer, staff within 16 blocks stop to watch, a nod, confetti, the jingle, the cut, the bell, and "Congratulations on your promotion."$(br2)Nobody may hurt the candidate meanwhile.

You keep both halves. The $(l)head$() makes half again its species' rate at a Cerebral Array: three promoted heads an Array, the rest at the plain rate. The $(l)body$() stays standing, a host at 50%% sync with you.

A seconded Team Lead is promoted from the Roster: $(l)Promote$() within 8 blocks of its clock.$(br2)Never with a Separation Chair running within 32 blocks, never during a strike. Slimes and the like go whole.$(br2)$(o)The Board does not take interns. It has tried.$()
